description: Submit a persistent job and return data.job_id with status=queued before registry enumeration. Read the complete former response envelope from job_service.get_job for that exact id. Admission does not assert the walk or guard installation has completed. Read the same complete owner projection as list_schedules, filtered by tag after enumeration. Each row includes action_definitions, targets, revision, error_message and runtime job presence/revision. count is the number returned after filtering; complete describes source enumeration. Unknown or unavailable liveness never removes a schedule.
embedding_description: Persistent scheduler-family job admission. Read the same complete owner projection as list_schedules, filtered by tag after enumeration. Each row includes action_definitions, targets, revision, error_message and runtime job presence/revision. count is the number returned after filtering; complete describes source enumeration. result_processor_customizations.result_description: The admission contains job_id and queued status. The exact job.result retains the complete registry or guard-install result described here: Read the same complete owner projection as list_schedules, filtered by tag after enumeration. Each row includes action_definitions, targets, revision, error_message and runtime job presence/revision. count is the number returned after filtering; complete describes source enumeration. Unknown or unavailable liveness never removes a schedule.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show completeness, holder observation, revision and activation advisories explicitly. A registered route is an observation, not a delivery guarantee.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read current revision before a mutation. Recovery is a separate explicit action. Pre-boundary queued work is unchanged.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A stale revision or invalid lifecycle transition is a data-integrity refusal; unavailable observations are advisories.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the current owner projection and history, then make an explicit correction with its current revision. Do not recreate a schedule to bypass a stale revision.
